__comment: Group 34 item A (rev 2026-07-24) - the whole wheel face as ONE flat double-sided quad carrying the baked customblocks:block/wheel_face texture. Replaces the ~850 TEXT_DISPLAY colour-quads: strips could not hold a clean radial seam in game because their 0.002-block depth order does not survive translucent rendering, so every boundary stair-stepped. A raster has no ordering to lose. No parent, so every ModelTransformationMode is identity and the ITEM_DISPLAY's 'none' mode renders the model raw: [0,16] model units map to [-0.5,+0.5] blocks, i.e. the disc is centred on the entity. FACES: south uses the default UVs, so from the front the face reads exactly as baked. North is U-flipped ([16,0,0,16] instead of the default [0,0,16,16]), which MIRRORS it for a viewer standing behind - matching the icon ring, whose physical positions are themselves mirrored from back there, so wedge and icon still line up slice for slice.
